text:
jane_cust: Hey team — hitting an error from the /rerank endpoint after switching to our new client. Worked before but now we see a 413 and a vague message: "input too large". Happening for requests with ~120 docs (~avg 2k chars each). Any guidance?

sam_support: Sorry you're running into this. Can you paste the exact error and a minimal curl or payload (sanitized)? Also which model/endpoint you called?

jane_cust: Error body: "error: rerank input too large" and HTTP 413. Using ruby client v2 -> POST /v1/rerank with model: "re-ranker-open-1". Repro snippet (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \n -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n -d '{"query":"<user query>","docs":[{"id":"1","text":"... 2k chars ..."}, {"id":"2","text":"..."}, ... up to 120 docs]}'
```

lee_sre: Thanks — that helps. Quick note: the platform limit is enforced on tokenized input (model tokens across query+docs) rather than raw char length. 120 docs * 2k chars will tokenize a lot. We're seeing requests exceed our 64k token soft limit in some infra paths which returns 413. Do you have approximate token counts?

jane_cust: Not easily — our client didn't expose tokens. We only measured chars. Previously we were under the limits at ~40 documents, but after the client change it batches more docs per request.

sam_support: Two immediate workarounds: 1) Reduce docs per request (start with 32) 2) Pre-filter with embeddings to rank a small candidate set, then call /rerank for top N. Both reduce token footprint.

jane_cust: Okay we'll try chunking. Quick question: can the API return a clearer error with current tokens vs max_tokens? The 413 makes it hard to show actionable guidance to our users.

max_engineer: @sam I agree — we should include token usage in the error payload and a recommended max_docs value per model. Current message is too opaque. I can take a look but need the original request id and server logs.

sam_support: jane_cust — can you share the x-request-id from the response headers (if present) or a timestamp+utc so we can find logs? Also which region?

jane_cust: Response headers include x-request-id: req_20240315_8f9c. Region: us-central1. Timestamp: 2024-03-15T21:33:10Z.

opsbot: Incident tracker created — INC-4392 — rerank: improve 413 messaging to include token usage and per-model limits. Assigned to eng-runtime (max_engineer). Priority: P3.

lee_sre: I pulled the logs for req_20240315_8f9c — server returned 413 after kernel path rejected request at token_expansion stage. Token estimate: ~71k tokens (limit: 65536). We also saw the client sent docs in a single batch, so expansion blew past the limit.

max_engineer: Thanks @lee_sre. I'll add a short-term change to make the 413 response include: {"error":"input too large","tokens":71000,"limit":65536}. For long term, we should add a preflight token-estimate endpoint and guidance in docs.

sam_support: For now, suggested instructions to the customer: reduce docs per rerank call to <= 30 for your average doc size, or prefilter; if you want we can help run tokenization on a sample payload and recommend exact max_docs.

jane_cust: Would appreciate a tokenization sample. I'll DM a redacted payload.

max_engineer: Got the DM — reproduced locally. Proposed fix: change 413 payload (non-breaking) and add a link to docs + UI note. I'll open a small PR, will try to ship a rollout to canary in us-central later this week.

lee_sre: Also adding a temporary server-side heuristic: if total docs > 64 and avg chars/doc > 1500, auto-return a friendlier 400 with the token estimate to prevent confusing 413s. Not ideal but reduces customer pain until preflight exists.

sam_support: Thanks everyone. jane_cust — trying the chunking approach should unblock you quickly. We'll update this thread when the 413 message is updated so your integration can show actionable text. :thumbsup: 

jane_cust: Awesome — thanks for the quick help. Will report back after testing.

max_engineer: Follow-up: PR #6543 opened (eng/runtime). Will include tests and feature flag. I'll post canary rollout time in #eng-releases once merged.

opsbot: INC-4392 updated: status -> in_progress, owner -> max_engineer, eta -> 2024-03-22

sam_support: Noted. Marking this as customer escalation resolved for now; re-open if 413 persists after the change.

jane_cust: Confirmed workaround worked (chunked to 25 docs). Thanks all!
